svg.title: Mirror heat fields differ away from the center, but center time series coincide; a separate panel shows floating-point roundoff.
svg.desc: Two alternative initial pulses, not two simultaneous sources. With A=1 and D=0.05 on the reflecting unit interval, the t=0.24 heat fields differ while their x=0.5 time series coincide analytically. The final panel exposes only finite-precision evaluation residuals; the curves in the middle panel overlap intentionally. All quantities are dimensionless.
